articles.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations

articles.title: Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says

articles.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker

articles.title: I quit my marketing job to walk dogs for 4 months: It's 'one of the most valuable professional experiences I've ever had'

articles.title: Amgen says drug combo cuts risk of death by 58% in patients with aggressive lung cancer
